additionalItems: {title} must NOT have more than {limit} additional item | {title} must NOT have more than {limit} additional items
anyOf: {title} must match at least one of the schemas in 'anyOf'
const: {title} must be equal to the allowed value
dependencies: {title} must have property {property} when property {dependency} is present
enum: {title} must be equal to one of the allowed values
if: {title} must match 'then' schema | {title} must match 'else' schema
maxItems: {title} must NOT have more than {maxItems} item | {title} must NOT have more than {maxItems} items
maxLength: {title} must NOT be longer than {maxLength} character | {title} must NOT be longer than {maxLength} characters
maxProperties: {title} must NOT have more than {maxProperties} property | {title} must NOT have more than {maxProperties} properties
maximum: {title} must be less than or equal to {maximum}
minItems: {title} must NOT have fewer than {minItems} item | {title} must NOT have fewer than {minItems} items
minLength: {title} must NOT be shorter than {minLength} character | {title} must NOT be shorter than {minLength} characters
minProperties: {title} must NOT have fewer than {minProperties} property | {title} must NOT have fewer than {minProperties} properties
minimum: {title} must be greater than or equal to {minimum}
not: {title} must NOT be valid according to schema in 'not'
oneOf: {title} must match exactly one of the schemas in 'oneOf'
uniqueItems: {title} must NOT have duplicate items (items {j} and {i} are identical)
